taskOverrides.topology: Dense FSDP=8 cross-node · Expert FSDP=8 cross-node · EP=1
taskOverrides.scope: Complete 2-layer forward + loss + backward · analytical NDR400 FSDP
description: This analytical variant keeps every measured compute duration and the dependency-ordered EP=1 schedule, changing only FSDP communication to cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.
Each rank is modeled with one 400 Gb/s rail: 50 GB/s peak and 42.5 GB/s effective. Eight node rails do not provide 400 GB/s to each rank.
With all 128 experts under FSDP=8, one expert AG moves 3.9375 GiB per rank and one FP32 expert RS moves 7.875 GiB per rank.
taskOverrides.insight: With EP=1 over InfiniBand, each expert all-gather takes about 100 ms and each expert reduce-scatter about 200 ms.

verification.label: Analytical NDR400 model · 42.5 GB/s effective per rank
verification.implementation: Measured EP=1 expert-FSDP dependency graph with byte-derived cross-node collectives
verification.workload: Same two Qwen-shaped layers; FSDP=8 for dense and all 128 experts; EP=1.
verification.measurement: 768.018 ms modeled collective window; compute durations unchanged from H100 capture.
